Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
A new version of the archon is available on the  download page : 1.5i

It includes two fixes:
- for 3R+F / 19 players, the 13th and 14th players were swapped on round 1, leading to possible bad seating
- for 2R+F / 44 players, the seating was worse than in 1.5g.

The archons must be used either with Excel or LibreOffice (not OpenOffice).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
